name: 血蘭-KETURAN
detailed_description:
I wake up in an unknown mansion.... I have amnesia and I don't know who I am.

Who am I? Why am I in this mansion?

You, the player, will reveal the truth about this mansion.

■This is an exploratory horror adventure that can be played in FPS.

You can collect all endings in 1 to 1.5 hours.

[Story]

The main character wakes up in an unknown mansion. He has amnesia, does not know who he is, and does not know where he is. As he searches for a way out of the mansion, he encounters ugly, inhuman monsters. Will the protagonist be able to reach the truth?

Is the ugliest thing in the world a ghost that has ceased to be human? Or is it a living person?

Make your choice and reveal the truth.

Controls

WASD / Walk

Left Shift/Run

Left click / interact/ Kick the sliding door

TAB / Pause screen

F／Turn on/off the light

■Video Distribution Guidelines

Although there are no specifications for video submission sites or applications, please do not submit videos from sites or applications that may be involved in adult content. No confirmation is required when posting videos. Editing is also allowed.

We also allow videos that combine the contributor's face, body, V, etc.

Thumbnails, etc. with titles or play images are also acceptable.

However, the following conditions must be observed.

(1) Do not use misleading thumbnails, videos, or content.

(2) The link to this work must be written in the summary section or in a place where it can be written.

4) If you do not comply with even one of the above conditions, we will ask you to delete the video or content.

■Prohibited items

(3) Posting only images of this work, or posting anything that has nothing to do with this work. (Images from the store page or images I post are OK.)

If you do not abide by these prohibitions and conditions, I will ask you to remove the video/content.

For anything else that I deem to be OUT, I may contact you.

FMGames will not be held responsible for anything that happens as a result of playing or posting this work.

That is all.

short_description: "KETSURAN" is an FPS exploration horror game. You suddenly find yourself in a mansion you don't recognize... Can the protagonist, who has lost his memory, escape from the mansion filled with hatred? Let's uncover the whole truth.
